name: mcode_git
description: Run a git operation in the workspace. op ∈ status | diff | commit | push | pull. `commit` needs a message (stages all changes, then commits with the account's identity). `push`/`pull` authenticate via a freshly-minted GitHub App token and use `branch` (defaults to the workspace branch). status/diff are read-only; commit/push/pull need the write scope. Returns { op, output, exit_code, ok }.

branch.description: Branch for push/pull; defaults to the workspace branch.
